article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-dominant hybrid
Genetics: Jack’s Cleaner × Space Queen
Breeder: TGA Subcool Seeds
THC Content: 20–25%
CBD Content: Low (<1%)
Terpene Profile: Terpinolene, Limonene, Pinene
Primary Flavors: Sharp lemon, sweet citrus, herbal haze
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to early October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 16–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Few marijuana strains carry a name as striking as Jack the Ripper , but behind the provocative title lies one of the most recognizable citrus-forward cannabis cultivars created during the modern breeding era. Developed by Subcool of TGA Genetics, this hybrid blends the bright citrus intensity of Jack’s Cleaner with the fruity sweetness of Space Queen, resulting in a plant that produces exceptionally aromatic flowers and powerful cerebral effects.

What distinguishes this cultivar from many other sativa-dominant strains is the intensity of its terpene profile. Opening a jar often releases a blast of sharp lemon and grapefruit that immediately fills the room. The aroma alone signals the energetic character of the weed inside. For enthusiasts seeking a vibrant daytime cannabis experience paired with bold citrus flavor, this hybrid remains one of the most memorable options produced by TGA’s breeding program.
Genetics and Lineage

The creation of Jack the Ripper begins with Jack’s Cleaner, one of Subcool’s earlier breeding projects that itself descends from Jack Herer genetics. Jack’s Cleaner gained attention for its extremely pungent citrus aroma and uplifting cerebral effects. Plants from this line frequently produce bright lemon and grapefruit terpene profiles driven by high levels of limonene and terpinolene.

The second parent, Space Queen, was another TGA creation that combined Romulan with Cinderella 99 . This lineage introduced additional sweetness and fruit character to the cross while also stabilizing the plant’s growth structure. Space Queen contributed dense resin production and a tropical undertone that softens the sharp citrus edge inherited from the Jack’s Cleaner side.

Bringing these two lines together resulted in a hybrid that expresses strong sativa influence while maintaining manageable flowering times. Many phenotypes emphasize the lemon-heavy terpene signature of Jack’s Cleaner, while others lean slightly sweeter with hints of pineapple and tropical fruit from Space Queen. Regardless of phenotype variation, the strain consistently produces resinous flowers with a distinct citrus-dominant aromatic identity.
Effects and Experience

The psychoactive experience begins quickly, often appearing within moments after inhalation. Instead of gradually building, the cerebral stimulation tends to arrive with noticeable clarity. Thoughts become more active, and mental focus sharpens in a way that many consumers describe as invigorating rather than overwhelming. This energetic opening reflects the cultivar’s sativa-dominant lineage.

As the high develops, the mental stimulation often shifts toward creativity and elevated mood. Many cannabis enthusiasts find the strain well suited for activities that benefit from imaginative thinking or sustained concentration. Conversations can become more engaging, music may feel more immersive, and routine tasks sometimes take on a more enjoyable rhythm.

Physical effects remain relatively light compared with heavy indica hybrids . While the body may feel relaxed, the dominant sensation stays centered in the mind. Larger doses, however, can intensify the cerebral stimulation and occasionally introduce a slightly racy mental energy. For that reason, newer cannabis consumers often prefer moderate amounts when exploring the strain for the first time.
Medical Benefits

Medical marijuana patients frequently turn to Jack the Ripper for its uplifting mental effects. Individuals dealing with stress or low mood sometimes find that the strain’s energetic cerebral influence helps create a brighter emotional outlook. The clear-headed nature of the experience allows many patients to remain functional while still benefiting from mood elevation.

Fatigue is another concern that this hybrid may help address. Because the high leans toward stimulation rather than sedation, the weed can serve as a daytime option for people who want symptom relief without feeling sluggish. The lively mental effect may help restore motivation or focus during periods of low energy.

Some patients also explore this cultivar for mild discomfort and tension headaches . While it is not typically considered a heavy analgesic strain, the combination of mental uplift and gentle physical relaxation can reduce the perceived intensity of certain types of discomfort. As with many cannabis varieties, effectiveness may vary depending on individual physiology and dosage.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Few cannabis strains deliver citrus intensity with the same clarity as this one. When properly cured, the aroma leaps out of the jar with sharp lemon zest and grapefruit peel. These bright notes dominate the profile and often carry a sweet candy-like quality that resembles lemon drops or citrus soda.

Breaking apart the buds releases deeper aromatic layers. Beneath the citrus surface lies a subtle blend of pine resin and herbal spice. The presence of terpinolene contributes a slightly floral character, while small amounts of myrcene add a grounding earthiness that balances the otherwise bright fragrance.

The flavor mirrors the scent closely. Inhalation brings forward vibrant lemon and sweet grapefruit, followed by hints of tropical fruit inherited from the Space Queen parent. During the exhale, the sweetness fades into a light herbal pine finish that lingers on the palate. This combination of candy-like citrus and subtle haze spice makes the smoke both refreshing and memorable.
Growing Information

Cultivating Jack the Ripper requires moderate experience but rewards attentive growers with high terpene production and resin-heavy flowers. The plant tends to exhibit vigorous growth during the vegetative stage , often stretching noticeably once flowering begins. Because of this growth pattern, many indoor cultivators use training techniques such as topping or low-stress training to maintain a manageable canopy.

Flowering typically completes within eight to nine weeks indoors, which is relatively fast for a sativa-dominant cannabis strain. During the final weeks, dense clusters of bright green buds form along the branches, often covered in thick layers of trichomes. Maintaining good airflow is important because the plant’s vigorous foliage can create dense canopy conditions.

Outdoor cultivation thrives in warm, sunny climates. When grown outside with ample space, the plant can reach impressive heights and produce large yields of aromatic flowers. Harvest generally occurs in early October in Northern Hemisphere climates. Many growers note that cooler nighttime temperatures near harvest can intensify the citrus terpene profile .
FAQ
What strain is Jack the Ripper? Jack the Ripper is a sativa-dominant cannabis hybrid created by Subcool of TGA Genetics. It is produced by crossing Jack’s Cleaner with Space Queen.
Is Jack the Ripper indica or sativa? The strain is considered strongly sativa-dominant. Its effects emphasize mental stimulation, creativity, and energy rather than heavy body sedation.

How strong is Jack the Ripper? THC levels commonly range from 18% to 24%, though potency can vary depending on cultivation and phenotype selection. The cerebral effects can feel quite powerful for some users.

What does Jack the Ripper smell like? The aroma features intense lemon and grapefruit notes with hints of tropical fruit, pine, and herbal spice. Many people describe it as one of the most citrus-forward marijuana strains available.

Is Jack the Ripper good for daytime use? Yes. Because the effects tend to be energetic and mentally stimulating, many cannabis users prefer it for daytime activities, creative work, or social settings.
Final Thoughts on Jack the Ripper

Within the diverse landscape of modern cannabis breeding , Jack the Ripper remains one of the most recognizable citrus-dominant hybrids produced by the TGA Genetics program. Its combination of bright lemon terpenes, energetic cerebral effects, and strong resin production has made it a favorite among enthusiasts who appreciate vibrant sativa-style marijuana.

The strain’s lineage merges several influential cannabis genetics, bringing together the uplifting characteristics of Jack’s Cleaner with the fruity sweetness and structural stability of Space Queen. This heritage gives the plant a distinctive aromatic identity while also ensuring consistent performance in cultivation environments .

For growers, the plant offers impressive terpene intensity and vigorous growth. For consumers, it delivers an experience centered on mental clarity, creativity, and bright citrus flavor. Those seeking a lively daytime weed with bold aroma and engaging cerebral effects will likely find this cultivar to be a memorable addition to their cannabis rotation.
